_comment: "When this attacks, you may put a shuriken item from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck. If you do, this gets +1{p}. Go again" The previous version was a MOVE_REF reading `shuriken_item`, a name nothing in the ability ever set, so the move silently did nothing -- while MODIFY_ATTACK sat beside it as a SIBLING and applied anyway. Built states showed the card at 4{p} with an EMPTY graveyard, and with a shuriken present the shuriken was still there afterwards: the cost was never paid either way, so the card was strictly stronger than printed (the costs-vs-effects class). It could not be authored correctly before: the *_REF family needs a reference, and the only producers (LOOK_AT, SELECT_FROM_REF) cannot reach a graveyard, so SELECT_FROM_ZONE was added for it. Now the selection stores the chosen shuriken under `picked`, MOVE_REF bottoms exactly that card, and the +1{p} is gated on REF_EXISTS so 'if you do' is real -- declining, or having no shuriken, grants nothing. `optional: true` on the selection is what lets the player back out after seeing the choices, which is the second half of 'you may'. Go again is printed and unconditional, so it stays a plain PLAY ability.
